record.bible_text: The word<WH01697> of the LORD<WH03068> that came unto Hosea<WH01954>, the son<WH01121> of Beeri<WH0882>, in the days<WH03117> of Uzziah<WH05818>, Jotham<WH03147>, Ahaz<WH0271>, <FI>and<Fi> Hezekiah<WH03169>, kings<WH04428> of Judah<WH03063>, and in the days<WH03117> of Jeroboam<WH03379> the son<WH01121> of Joash<WH03101>, king<WH04428> of Israel<WH03478>.<CM>

And the LORD<WH03068> said<WH0559><WTH8799> to Hosea<WH01954>, Go<WH03212><WTH8798>, take<WH03947><WTH8798> unto thee a wife<WH0802> of whoredoms<WH02183> and children<WH03206> of whoredoms<WH02183>: for the land<WH0776> hath committed great<WH02181><WTH8800> whoredom<WH02181><WTH8799>, <FI>departing<Fi> from<WH0310> the LORD<WH03068>.

And the LORD<WH03068> said<WH0559><WTH8799> unto him, Call<WH07121><WTH8798> his name<WH08034> Jezreel<WH03157>; for yet a little<WH04592> <FI>while<Fi> , and I will avenge<WH06485><WTH8804> the blood<WH01818> of Jezreel<WH03157> upon the house<WH01004> of Jehu<WH03058>, and will cause to cease<WH07673><WTH8689> the kingdom<WH04468> of the house<WH01004> of Israel<WH03478>. <RF>avenge: Heb. visit<Rf>
And it shall come to pass at that day<WH03117>, that I will break<WH07665><WTH8804> the bow<WH07198> of Israel<WH03478> in the valley<WH06010> of Jezreel<WH03157>.

And she conceived again<WH02029><WTH8799>, and bare<WH03205><WTH8799> a daughter<WH01323>. And <FI>God<Fi> said<WH0559><WTH8799> unto him, Call<WH07121><WTH8798> her name<WH08034> Loruhamah<WH03819><WTH8795>: for I will no more<WH03254><WTH8686> have mercy<WH07355><WTH8762> upon the house<WH01004> of Israel<WH03478>; but I will utterly<WH05375><WTH8800> take them away<WH05375><WTH8799>. <RF>Loruhamah: that is, Not having obtained mercy<Rf> <RF>no...: Heb. not add any more to<Rf> <RF>but...: or, that I should altogether pardon them<Rf>

But I will have mercy<WH07355><WTH8762> upon the house<WH01004> of Judah<WH03063>, and will save<WH03467><WTH8689> them by the LORD<WH03068> their God<WH0430>, and will not save<WH03467><WTH8686> them by bow<WH07198>, nor by sword<WH02719>, nor by battle<WH04421>, by horses<WH05483>, nor by horsemen<WH06571>.<CM>
Now when she had weaned<WH01580><WTH8799> Loruhamah<WH03819><WTH8795>, she conceived<WH02029><WTH8799>, and bare<WH03205><WTH8799> a son<WH01121>.

Then said<WH0559><WTH8799> <FI>God<Fi> , Call<WH07121><WTH8798> his name<WH08034> Loammi<WH03818>: for ye <FI>are<Fi> not my people<WH05971>, and I will not be your <FI>God<Fi> . <RF>Loammi: that is, Not my people<Rf>

Yet the number<WH04557> of the children<WH01121> of Israel<WH03478> shall be as the sand<WH02344> of the sea<WH03220>, which cannot be measured<WH04058><WTH8735> nor numbered<WH05608><WTH8735>; and it shall come to pass, <FI>that<Fi> in the place<WH04725> where it was said<WH0559><WTH8735> unto them, Ye <FI>are<Fi> not my people<WH05971>, <FI>there<Fi> it shall be said<WH0559><WTH8735> unto them, <FI>Ye are<Fi> the sons<WH01121> of the living<WH02416> God<WH0410>. <RF>in...: or, instead of that<Rf>

Then shall the children<WH01121> of Judah<WH03063> and the children<WH01121> of Israel<WH03478> be gathered<WH06908><WTH8738> together<WH03162>, and appoint<WH07760><WTH8804> themselves one<WH0259> head<WH07218>, and they shall come up<WH05927><WTH8804> out of the land<WH0776>: for great<WH01419> <FI>shall be<Fi> the day<WH03117> of Jezreel<WH03157>.<CM>
